title: Move all components as one undoable step
summary: Shows how to change many PCB objects in one batch that a single Undo reverts, using either the PCB process messages sent with IPCB_Board.DispatchMessage or the PreProcess/PostProcess bracket, and how to run PCB:Undo from code.
phrasings: group many PCB edits into one undo
move every component on a board
make a batch change undoable with a single Ctrl+Z
trigger undo in the PCB editor from code

commands.name: MoveComponents
commands.description: Multiply every component's X location as one undo step
